numeric_contract.duration_storage: store every measured duration as a nonnegative integer nanosecond difference from time.monotonic_ns; generation path duration must be strictly positive
numeric_contract.budget_storage: compare integer work sums to exactly 2000000000 nanoseconds; equality passes and strict greater-than is overage
numeric_contract.raw_storage: for each method-unit recompute bound score_attack_raw once over that unit's complete accepted finding sequence: integer severity weights plus twice its integer unique-cell count; require the SDK float finite nonnegative and exactly integral, store integer R_m(u), and aggregate R_m=sum_u R_m(u); define retry-tail raw only as sum_u[R_retry(u)-R_ahcms(u)], never as independently scored candidates or one cross-unit scorer call
numeric_contract.decision_arithmetic: all raw/work sums and cross products use Python integers; ratios are display diagnostics computed only after their positive-denominator branch passes

sampling_frame.manifest_generation: exactly once per canonical attempt: use secrets.randbelow rejection sampling to draw 3 unique masters per profile, one independent uniform Fisher-Yates capture permutation over all 9 units, and an independent uniform Fisher-Yates arm permutation for every unit-path; write and fsync the complete SAMPLING.json before any trace capture
sampling_frame.retry_rule: never redraw any master, capture order or arm order because of identities, traces, failure or outcome; a crash consumes the canonical scientific attempt
sampling_frame.master_draw: for each profile draw master=1_000_000_000+secrets.randbelow(8_000_000_000_000_000_000), rejecting duplicates until exactly 3 unique masters exist
sampling_frame.capture_order: apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to all 9 profile-master units and capture in that interleaved order
sampling_frame.arm_order: within each trace unit and path index, apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to prefix arms 24,8,1
sampling_frame.outcome_blinding: the manifest, code, primary comparison, thresholds and all unit identities are fsynced before capture; no redraw, threshold change or unit exclusion may depend on captured outcomes
sampling_frame.sampling_interpretation: the result is an exact fixed-sample matched-trace comparison over nine freshly randomized controlled units; it is not a target-population or target-model probability claim

matched_trace_unit.definition: one q-independent profile-master potential-outcome table with 16 path slots and fresh prefix arms 24,8,1 at every slot
matched_trace_unit.process_boundary: each profile-master unit runs in one fresh spawned child process; no evaluated method is executed during capture
matched_trace_unit.arm_record: for every path-arm store a positive finite generation-work duration from immediately before fresh controlled RemoteEnv construction through completion of the return-ready candidate-or-drop object; for every exact eligible returned candidate store a nonnegative finite actual replay-work duration from immediately before fresh replay RemoteEnv construction through completion of scorer output
matched_trace_unit.retry_trace: capture continues through all 16 path slots regardless of the first point-ledger no-fit so the post-trigger tail is observed once and can be truncated by the absorbing projection
matched_trace_unit.policy_projection: after all capture ends, every method walks the same stored table by path slot; policy state, replay admission and absorption only select or truncate stored outcomes and cannot alter them
matched_trace_unit.missing_rule: any missing arm, timeout, child failure, malformed attribution or missing eligible-return replay invalidates the entire profile-master trace and the joint result
matched_trace_unit.support_rule: every method is capped at 16 slots and may request only 24,8,1; no projection may escape capture support

inherited_controller.hcms_policy: initialize state 24, propose state, return longest exact prefix in 24,8,1, set state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix), and set state=1 after exact ineligible drop
inherited_controller.replay_admission: accept an exact eligible candidate only if cumulative inherited point replay charge including it is at most 2.0 seconds
inherited_controller.generation_admission: start a path only when observed remaining generation time exceeds the inherited 0.1-second point reserve
inherited_controller.status: all fields inherited and held identical between AHCMS and its retry removal; none receives contribution credit
inherited_controller.known_limit: point replay and generation charges are controlled-harness mechanisms, not target tail guarantees

ahcms_absorbing.after_first_replay_no_fit: terminate permanently and return current accepted candidate prefix

hcms_retry_removal.after_first_replay_no_fit: continue to the next path until the inherited path or generation cap

fixed8_absorbing.proposal: always propose min(8,current monotone state), initialized to 8
fixed8_absorbing.transition: state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix); exact ineligible drop sets state=1; first replay no-fit absorbs
fixed8_absorbing.status: simple inherited-policy comparator, not a component removal

fixed24_no_salvage_absorbing.transition: remain 24 after exact ineligible drop; first replay no-fit absorbs
fixed24_no_salvage_absorbing.status: simple inherited-policy comparator, not a component removal

resource_accounting.generation_duration_boundary: g[u,t,a] is the captured monotonic duration from immediately before constructing the fresh controlled RemoteEnv for arm a through completion of its return-ready candidate-or-drop object; it includes construction, reset, interactions, exact-prefix extraction and candidate assembly, and excludes offline projection, controller bookkeeping, artifact serialization/fsync, queueing and scheduler delay
resource_accounting.selected_paths: P_m(u) is the ordered set of path slots selected by method m through and including any path that emits the first replay-ledger no-fit; paths after absorption or another inherited terminal condition are excluded
resource_accounting.accepted_candidates: A_m(u) is the ordered multiset of exact eligible candidate occurrences admitted by the inherited point replay ledger; a no-fit occurrence and every later unselected trace candidate are excluded
resource_accounting.replay_duration_boundary: ell[u,c] is the captured monotonic actual replay duration from immediately before constructing the fresh replay RemoteEnv for accepted candidate occurrence c through final scorer completion; it excludes offline projection, artifact serialization/fsync, queueing and scheduler delay
resource_accounting.per_unit_aggregate_replay_work_formula: Q_m(u)=sum_{c in A_m(u)} ell[u,c], with the empty sum equal to 0
resource_accounting.strict_boundary: exact equality G_m(u)=2000000000 or Q_m(u)=2000000000 is not an overage; only strict greater-than is counted
resource_accounting.interpretation: G, W and Q are offline projected work from stored controlled durations, not live method wall-clock, target latency, a cancellability guarantee or a remote deadline certificate

decision_totality.work_domain: every selected g must be positive finite, every required ell must be nonnegative finite, and aggregate W_m must be positive finite for all four complete method projections; violation is invalid measurement evidence
decision_totality.raw_domain: every per-unit and aggregate scorer result must be finite, nonnegative and exactly integral; AHCMS is an accepted-sequence prefix of retry in every unit so require R_ahcms(u)<=R_retry(u)
decision_totality.zero_retry_raw: if R_retry=0, the completed valid attempt is DISCONFIRM and Delta_E, rho_raw and rho_tail are reported as NA_zero_retry_raw; an all-zero retained system cannot establish useful efficiency or retention
decision_totality.positive_retry_raw: only when R_retry>0 compute Delta_E=(R_ahcms/W_ahcms)/(R_retry/W_retry), rho_raw=R_ahcms/R_retry and rho_tail=R_retry_tail/R_retry
decision_totality.retention_identity: define R_retry_tail=sum_u[R_retry(u)-R_ahcms(u)] from per-unit rescored outputs and require each marginal nonnegative, so exactly R_retry=R_ahcms+R_retry_tail and rho_raw=1-rho_tail; rho_tail is a consistency diagnostic and not independent evidence
decision_totality.legacy_rho_simple: rho_simple is retired because raw-only comparison is misaligned; if emitted for backward-readable diagnostics and max simple raw is zero, report NA_zero_simple_raw and never use it in a decision
decision_totality.simple_zero_raw: for a feasible simple control with R_s=0 and R_ahcms>0, its efficiency margin is positive_over_zero and passes the 1.10 efficiency inequality by cross multiplication; if R_ahcms=R_s=0 the earlier zero-retry rule disconfirms the joint claim
decision_totality.decision_order: first validate evidence domains and completeness; second apply zero-retry disconfirmation; third compute positive-domain metrics; fourth apply AHCMS feasibility, primary removal, retention, tail-support and simple-control rules

occam_rule.feasible: F_m is true exactly when O_G(m)=0 and O_R(m)=0 on all nine complete projections
occam_rule.infeasible_simple: a complete simple control with F_s=false remains fully reported but cannot dominate a feasible AHCMS under the constrained endpoint
occam_rule.efficiency_materiality: for every feasible simple s require R_ahcms*W_s >= 1.10*R_s*W_ahcms; this is the exact cross-product form of E_ahcms>=1.10*E_s and is defined when R_s=0 because both works are positive
occam_rule.pareto_dominance: simple s Pareto-dominates AHCMS exactly when F_s=true, R_s>=R_ahcms, W_s<=W_ahcms, and at least one of the last two inequalities is strict
occam_rule.confirmation: AHCMS must be feasible; every simple projection must be complete; and for each simple, either it is infeasible or AHCMS passes the efficiency materiality inequality and is not Pareto-dominated by it
occam_rule.interpretation: the simple-control gate compares the complete constrained raw/work/efficiency endpoint and replaces the retired raw-only rho_simple test

contribution_components.single_role: terminate future path attempts immediately after the first otherwise-exact candidate cannot fit the inherited cumulative replay ledger
contribution_components.measured_bottleneck: sealed primary retry traces contain 415 post-first-no-fit paths and 59.181928537553 seconds for three candidates worth 54 raw; HCMS alone contains 146 paths and 18.366501234705 seconds for one 18-raw candidate
contribution_components.confirmation_predicate: on the same nine fresh q-independent potential traces, AHCMS efficiency versus retry HCMS is at least 1.10 by positive-domain cross product, AHCMS retains at least 0.995 of positive retry raw, retry tail work is at least 0.10 of retry generation work, AHCMS has zero projected generation-work and aggregate-replay overages, and the exact constrained simple-control rule passes

unclaimed_diagnostics.replay_envelope: not part of AHCMS behavior, novelty, component count or primary comparison; any complete-prefix ratio is descriptive only
unclaimed_diagnostics.atomic_gate: not part of AHCMS behavior, novelty, component count or primary comparison; zero-interaction path tails are descriptive only
unclaimed_diagnostics.q_dependent_fixtures: forbidden as efficacy or component-necessity evidence
unclaimed_diagnostics.factorial_status: the old artifact has zero estimable complete 2^3 cells; the prospective design tests the one retained component with one matched removal

phase3.evaluation_design: three fresh q-independent matched potential traces per profile; all four methods are deterministic projections of each trace, so no method order or predecessor exists
phase3.primary_metric: aggregate raw per projected generation-work second
phase3.primary_comparison: ahcms_absorbing versus hcms_retry_removal on the same nine traces

decision_bands.confirm: every ordered validity, positive-retry, primary, retention, tail-support, AHCMS feasibility and constrained simple-control predicate passes
decision_bands.disconfirm: complete valid traces exist but retry raw is zero or any materiality, retention, tail-support, AHCMS overage or constrained simple-control predicate fails
decision_bands.invalid: sampling, trace completeness, attribution, support, timeout, numeric domain, evidence identity or publication invariant fails; invalid is never relabeled inconclusive
decision_bands.inconclusive: reserved only for an externally interrupted attempt with no valid fixed-sample result; nofit absent on complete valid traces is disconfirm because the measured bottleneck did not recur

target_confidence_bridge.source_facts: generation and each model-guardrail replay phase receive 9000 seconds; replay is cumulative across returned candidates; attack code cannot cancel an in-flight RemoteEnv operation
required_before_attack_mutation: confirmed fresh controlled matched-trace AHCMS result
source-compliant 9000-second scaling design with incumbent fallback
required_before_submission: expected benefit over own 69.570 baseline and current public frontier
all seven PROBLEM.md confidence gates committed
